en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a long neoclassical palace building with arcades and many windows, set behind an open square where people in traditional dress walk and riders on horseback move across the foreground. The sky is lightly clouded. At the bottom left, a caption in French reads "Le Caire. Palais d'Abdin." There are handwritten signatures and a circular postal or archive stamp on the lower part of the card.
